name: How can I prepare my kitchen for backsplash installation?

mainEntity.name: How can I prepare my kitchen for backsplash installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before backsplash installation, clear all items from your countertops and surrounding areas to provide unobstructed access for our team. Removing small appliances, decor, and any hanging items from the walls is helpful. While we protect your surfaces, covering countertops and flooring with drop cloths or plastic sheets can offer additional peace of mind. Ensuring clear pathways and access to power outlets also contributes to a smoother and more efficient installation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare your kitchen by clearing countertops and surrounding areas, removing small appliances, and ensuring clear access and power outlets for installers.
